text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ummm, is this the right way... I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm so excited!
Still, an indoor festival
is quite unusual, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It looks like they won't have portable shrines,
but there'll be lots of food stalls lined up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If it's indoors, we don't have to worry even if it rains...
I'm really looking forward to it too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Dia-chan and the others
haven't arrived yet...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Spe-san!
Did you find any stalls!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't find any!
Ah, but it looks like they're selling drinks
and stuff over that way!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even so... it's so lively in here.
I had no idea there was a festival like this!

When I stopped by a live house for a change of pace,
I spotted Kitasan Black and Special Week there.

Today was a community-sponsored singing and dancing event
featuring student bands, but...

Even so, it was clearly not the kind of festival with food stalls
that the two of them were talking about.
Feeling puzzled, I watched on—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Spe-san, let's try dancing too!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? But I don't think I can pull off
the kind of dance everyone else is doing...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A festival is still a festival,
so a Bon festival dance should work just fine, right!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-You're right! In that case—

Matching the intense music,
the two began doing a traditional Bon dance.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yo, heeve-ho, and there we go!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hoi, hoisa, hoisassa!

What an astonishing sight.
Watching the two of them dance—

The whole place began to look just like
a summer festival venue...! And it seemed
the other customers felt the same way—

text_block_list.name: Dancing Man
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? What the...
Watching those two just gave me
an irresistible urge to dance the Bon Odori!?

text_block_list.name: Dancing Woman
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?!
Bon Odori to techno music is so fresh!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Everyone else is starting to do the Bon Odori too...?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! That's the spirit!
A festival just has to be like this, desu ne!
The two continued to dance after that, and then—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Phew... It's gotten completely dark outside, desu ne.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Come to think of it,
I wonder what happened to Dia-chan and the others.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right.
I couldn't find anyone else either...
Let's give them a call—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, finally found you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've been searching everywhere for you~.
Did you get the wrong place by any chance?
The venue is actually further ahead down the street.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Eh?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? But if that's true...
then that means this place isn't
the festival venue at all...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That can't be...
I mean, we were just dancing the Bon Odori with everyone, weren't we?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That place is... a club, Kita-chan.
Spe-san too... wait,
did you really dance the Bon Odori in there?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
............
...Pfft, fufu, you two are incredible...
Aha, ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: D-Don't laugh at us--!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I can't help it... That's our Kita-chan for you!
A true festival girl, indeed.

Lively laughter echoed into the night, 
carrying the lingering warmth of a festival.
